items.text: Bertina E. Lampkin has served on the Illinois Appellate Court, First District, since 2009. She previously was an assistant state's attorney and an assistant corporation counsel. She also served as a circuit judge supervising the domestic violence courts and the criminal division. She has chaired Illinois Supreme Court committees on criminal law and probation administration and on pattern instructions in criminal cases.
